alt: 主管靠在椅上伸手取甜點，神情自滿而不參與工作；同事在桌邊認真討論社區模型。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 腦滿腸肥 literally describes a full, plump appearance and figuratively criticizes someone who indulges in food and comfort while lacking concern or substance. Show a comfortably plump middle-aged manager in a neat suit leaning back at the head of a meeting table, complacently reaching for pastries and looking uninterested, while a few colleagues quietly work through a useful community project model and blank unlabeled charts. Convey the critique through his self-satisfied idleness and overfull snack plate, not ridicule or shame his body; body proportions realistic, no grotesque exaggeration. Natural anatomy, all limbs and fingers correct, grounded chairs and cups. No text anywhere.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO readable text, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks or recognizable existing characters. Contemporary office meeting. Delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor, colored-pencil grain/hatching on warm ivory textured paper, restrained natural colors, no 3D.
